import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from keras.models import Model
from keras.layers import (
    Input,
    Embedding,
    LSTM,
    Dense,
    Bidirectional,
    TimeDistributed,
    Attention,
    Concatenate,
)
from keras.preprocessing.sequence import pad_sequences
from keras.utils import to_categorical
import re

# Suppress warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")

# Sort by sentence to ensure proper context
train_df = train_df.sort_values(["sentence_id", "token_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)
test_df = test_df.sort_values(["sentence_id", "token_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

# Extract unique tokens and their normalized forms
tokens = list(
    set(train_df["before"].astype(str).unique())
    | set(train_df["after"].astype(str).unique())
)
tokens = sorted(tokens)
token2idx = {t: i + 1 for i, t in enumerate(tokens)}
token2idx["<PAD>"] = 0
idx2token = {i: t for t, i in token2idx.items()}

# Extract classes if present for additional feature
classes = []
if "class" in train_df.columns:
    classes = list(set(train_df["class"].astype(str).unique()))
    classes = sorted(classes)
    class2idx = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
    class2idx["<PAD>"] = len(classes)
    idx2class = {i: c for c, i in class2idx.items()}

# Prepare character-level vocabulary
char_set = set()
for token in tokens + list(
    "абвгдеёжзийклмнопрстуфхцчшщъыьэюяАБВГДЕЁЖЗИЙКЛМНОПРСТУФХЦЧШЩЪЫЬЭЮЯ0123456789.,;:!?-_"
    + "trans"
):
    for c in str(token):
        char_set.add(c)
char_list = sorted(list(char_set))
char2idx = {c: i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(char_list)}
char2idx["<PAD>"] = 0
idx2char = {i: c for c, i in char2idx.items()}


# Build context features for training (prev/next tokens)
def add_context(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df["prev_before"] = df.groupby("sentence_id")["before"].shift(1).fillna("")
    df["next_before"] = df.groupby("sentence_id")["before"].shift(-1).fillna("")
    if "class" in df.columns:
        df["prev_class"] = df.groupby("sentence_id")["class"].shift(1).fillna("")
        df["next_class"] = df.groupby("sentence_id")["class"].shift(-1).fillna("")
    return df


train_df = add_context(train_df)


# Tokenize before and after
def encode_tokens(series, token2idx):
    return [[token2idx.get(str(t), 0) for t in series]]


def encode_chars(series):
    result = []
    for token in series:
        token = str(token)
        result.append([char2idx.get(c, 0) for c in token])
    return result


# Prepare character sequences for inputs (current + prev/next context)
def pad_chars(seqs, max_len):
    padded = []
    for seq in seqs:
        if len(seq) < max_len:
            padded.append(seq + [0] * (max_len - len(seq)))
        else:
            padded.append(seq[:max_len])
    return padded


# Prepare input sequences for LSTM model
def prepare_data(df, token2idx, char2idx, max_token_len=20, max_char_len=10):
    # Token sequences (context: prev, curr, next)
    prev_tokens = df["prev_before"].astype(str).values
    curr_tokens = df["before"].astype(str).values
    next_tokens = df["next_before"].astype(str).values

    # Encode current token characters
    curr_chars = encode_chars(curr_tokens)
    curr_chars = pad_chars(curr_chars, max_char_len)

    # Encode previous token characters
    prev_chars = encode_chars(prev_tokens)
    prev_chars = pad_chars(prev_chars, max_char_len)

    # Encode next token characters
    next_chars = encode_chars(next_tokens)
    next_chars = pad_chars(next_chars, max_char_len)

    # Target after tokens (encoded)
    after_tokens = df["after"].astype(str).values
    y = [token2idx.get(str(t), 0) for t in after_tokens]

    # If class is available, add as feature
    class_features = []
    if "class" in df.columns:
        prev_class = df["prev_class"].fillna("").astype(str).values
        next_class = df["next_class"].fillna("").astype(str).values
        prev_class = [class2idx.get(c, len(class2idx) - 1) for c in prev_class]
        next_class = [class2idx.get(c, len(class2idx) - 1) for c in next_class]
        class_features = list(zip(prev_class, next_class))

    return (curr_chars, prev_chars, next_chars), y, class_features


# Prepare training data
(X_curr, X_prev, X_next), y, class_features = prepare_data(
    train_df, token2idx, char2idx
)

# Convert to numpy arrays
X_curr = np.array(X_curr)
X_prev = np.array(X_prev)
X_next = np.array(X_next)
y = np.array(y)

# One-hot encode targets
num_classes = len(token2idx)
y_cat = to_categorical(y, num_classes=num_classes)

# Split for validation (hold-out)
(
    X_curr_tr,
    X_curr_val,
    X_prev_tr,
    X_prev_val,
    X_next_tr,
    X_next_val,
    y_cat_tr,
    y_cat_val,
) = train_test_split(
    X_curr, X_prev, X_next, y_cat, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Define model
embedding_dim = 64
lstm_units = 64
char_embedding_dim = 32
max_char_len = X_curr.shape[1]

# Input layers
curr_input = Input(shape=(max_char_len,), name="curr_input")
prev_input = Input(shape=(max_char_len,), name="prev_input")
next_input = Input(shape=(max_char_len,), name="next_input")

# Character embedding
char_emb = Embedding(
    input_dim=len(char2idx),
    output_dim=char_embedding_dim,
    mask_zero=True,
    name="char_emb",
)

# Process each token's characters through LSTM
curr_chars = char_emb(curr_input)
prev_chars = char_emb(prev_input)
next_chars = char_emb(next_input)

# BiLSTM to capture character-level context
curr_lstm = Bidirectional(
    LSTM(lstm_units // 2, return_sequences=True), name="curr_bilstm"
)(curr_chars)
prev_lstm = Bidirectional(
    LSTM(lstm_units // 2, return_sequences=True), name="prev_bilstm"
)(prev_chars)
next_lstm = Bidirectional(
    LSTM(lstm_units // 2, return_sequences=True), name="next_bilstm"
)(next_chars)

# Attention over characters
curr_att = Attention(name="curr_att")([curr_lstm, curr_lstm])
prev_att = Attention(name="prev_att")([prev_lstm, prev_lstm])
next_att = Attention(name="next_att")([next_lstm, next_lstm])

# Average pooling to get token representation
curr_repr = Lambda(lambda x: tf.reduce_mean(x, axis=1))(curr_att)
prev_repr = Lambda(lambda x: tf.reduce_mean(x, axis=1))(prev_att)
next_repr = Lambda(lambda x: tf.reduce_mean(x, axis=1))(next_att)

# Concatenate representations
merged = Concatenate(name="concat")([prev_repr, curr_repr, next_repr])

# Final classification layer
dense = Dense(128, activation="relu")(merged)
output = Dense(num_classes, activation="softmax")(dense)

model = Model(inputs=[curr_input, prev_input, next_input], outputs=output)
model.compile(loss="categorical_crossentropy", optimizer="adam", metrics=["accuracy"])

# Train model
model.fit(
    [X_curr_tr, X_prev_tr, X_next_tr],
    y_cat_tr,
    validation_data=([X_curr_val, X_prev_val, X_next_val], y_cat_val),
    epochs=3,
    batch_size=128,
    verbose=0,
)

# Get validation accuracy
val_preds = model.predict([X_curr_val, X_prev_val, X_next_val], verbose=0)
val_pred_tokens = [idx2token[np.argmax(pred)] for pred in val_preds]
y_val_true = [idx2token[np.argmax(true)] for true in y_cat_val]
val_accuracy = sum(p == t for p, t in zip(val_pred_tokens, y_val_true)) / len(
    y_val_true
)
print(f"Validation accuracy (holdout 10%): {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Prepare test data
test_df = add_context(test_df)
(X_curr_test, X_prev_test, X_next_test), _, _ = prepare_data(
    test_df, token2idx, char2idx
)

X_curr_test = np.array(X_curr_test)
X_prev_test = np.array(X_prev_test)
X_next_test = np.array(X_next_test)

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model.predict([X_curr_test, X_prev_test, X_next_test], verbose=0)
test_pred_tokens = [idx2token[np.argmax(pred)] for pred in test_preds]

# Build submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str)
        + "_"
        + test_df["token_id"].astype(str),
        "after": test_pred_tokens,
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
